title: Ankhorage Repository Rules
summary: Provides reusable rules and metadata preflight evaluation for Ankhorage repositories.
purpose: Centralize repository policy so tooling can evaluate consistent repository facts without embedding policy in every consumer.
responsibilities: Define reusable repository, package, and tooling validation rules.
Expose advisory metadata preflight rules for inventory and authoring.
Provide canonical repository-policy facts to rule consumers.
boundaries: Does not acquire repository filesystem, network, or package-manager facts.
Does not make metadata preflight findings a default repository RuleSet gate.
Does not own authored metadata documents for other repositories.
audience: Rule runners that evaluate normalized repository facts.
useCases: Evaluate package and repository policy from host-acquired facts.
Preflight repository metadata during the organization inventory rollout.

architecture.role: A policy library that evaluates portable repository facts supplied by its host.
invariants: Metadata preflight is advisory and explicitly separate from the default repository RuleSet.
Rule evaluation remains independent of filesystem and parser implementations.

limitations: Callers must acquire and normalize repository facts before evaluation.
Doctor activation remains reserved until the verified organization inventory is complete.
